name: QueryStories

parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the story. For a list of valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743998.html
parameters.name: story_type

parameters.help_en: The subtype of the story. For a list of valid values, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2743998.html
parameters.name: story_sub_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the face clusters
parameters.name: figure_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en: The time range in which stories were created
parameters.name: create_time_range

parameters.help_en: The time range for the creation time of the first photo or video in the story
parameters.help_zh: 创建故事照片或视频的开始时间范围
parameters.name: story_start_time_range

parameters.help_en: The time range for the creation time of the last photo or video in the story
parameters.help_zh: 创建故事照片或视频的结束时间范围
parameters.name: story_end_time_range

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If you do not specify this token in the next request, results are returned from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 在查询结果过多需要翻页时使用，标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始；翻页读取时，则需传入上次调用该接口返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量。取值范围为[1,100]。默认值为100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The custom labels in key-value pairs
parameters.help_zh: 自定义标签键值对。查询满足此标签对的故事
parameters.name: custom_labels

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return empty stories. Valid values:

- true (The default value)

- false
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回空故事。取值范围如下：

- true（默认）：返回空故事。

- false：不返会空故事
parameters.name: with_empty_stories

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. Valid values:

- CreateTime: sorts by story creation time.

- StoryName: sorts by story name.

- StoryStartTime: sorts by story start time.

- StoryEndTime: sorts by story end time
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，取值范围如下：

- CreateTime：按故事创建时间排序。

- StoryName：按故事名称排序。

- StoryStartTime：按故事开始时间排序

- StoryEndTime：按故事结束时间排序
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- asc: in ascending order.

- desc: in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值范围如下：

- asc：升序。

- desc：降序
parameters.name: order
